items.hypothesis: Pipeline controls expose leakage and accounting defects.
items.falsifier: A deliberate future factor is not rejected.

items.hypothesis: Past medium-horizon ETF momentum may persist after costs.
items.falsifier: It does not beat frozen equal-weight ETF control robustly.

items.hypothesis: Lower historical volatility predicts lower-risk relative outcomes.
items.falsifier: Industry/size exposure or 2x costs fully explains the result.

items.hypothesis: Causal total-return momentum persists after costs.
items.falsifier: Net effect is negative or exists in only one validation block.

items.hypothesis: Short-horizon reversal varies by prior liquidity.
items.falsifier: Capacity or next-time execution removes the effect.

items.hypothesis: Index trend can defensively allocate between ETF and cash.
items.falsifier: Cash drag dominates without reliable crisis protection.

items.hypothesis: Low beta changes portfolio risk after historical exposure controls.
items.falsifier: Residual performance and risk contribution show no robust benefit.

items.hypothesis: Frozen EP BP or dividend yield predicts relative returns.
items.falsifier: Units, negative-value policy, or timing evidence invalidates it.

items.hypothesis: PIT ROE and cash-flow quality predict robust relative outcomes.
items.falsifier: Only final revisions or low-volatility proxies support the effect.

items.hypothesis: Selected announcements have delayed benchmark-adjusted response.
items.falsifier: Timestamp, clustering, mapping, or CAR evidence fails.
